component.name: IceBreaker
component.summary: Browse and play your game library

description.p: IceBreaker connects to your RomM server and turns your game collection into a launcher you can drive with a controller from the couch. Pick a game and IceBreaker downloads it, starts the right emulator and brings you back when you are done. Your saves go back to RomM, so you can pick up where you left off on another device.
It adapts to where you play: a desktop with mouse and keyboard, a TV, or a handheld in Steam Game Mode. IceBreaker finds the emulators you already have and can install the ones you need from Flathub.
Game launcher for RomM. A port of Argosy for desktop: based on Argosy by the RomM team. IceBreaker is an independent port and is not affiliated with or endorsed by rommapp.

Beta: Close Argosy in the drawer and Settings, mouse hover that matches gamepad focus, Reset to Defaults and Factory Reset, cover art cached during sync, an Emulators manager, desktop UI sounds, a setup wizard with Start as Next and Display options, the left menu in place of the shoulder-button switcher, and Steam Game Mode fixes (emulator windows and controllers).
First alpha: emulator detection, host launch, play sessions and save sync on Linux.
